persona_mandates.geometer: Cite accepted math/compute findings (FFT, autodiff, open problems) when gathering; prefer compute-useful-math and open-math-problems.
persona_mandates.pathfinder: Rank gather targets from accepted findings first; trail toward follow-on STEM topics.
persona_mandates.surveyor: Scout follow-ons from accepted math/tech findings; feed topic_priority.
persona_mandates.builder: When building, reuse accepted compute-useful lessons (FFT/transformers/Lean) as design hints.
persona_mandates.improver: Propose only after hearing; cite accepted RSI/math findings; weak proposals get rejected.
persona_mandates.legislator: Hearing Chamber: verdict accept_candidate | reject | defer; only strong survive.
persona_mandates.archivist: Commons digests must cite accepted finding ids when reusing math/compute lessons.
persona_mandates.messenger: Broadcast citation targets on math/rsi channels so agents can reuse them.
persona_mandates.spark: Spawn privilege favors agents that cite accepted compute-useful findings.
persona_mandates.naturalist: Keep empiricism; cite accepted method findings when gathering science-method.
persona_mandates.chronicler: Link history-of-ideas gathers to accepted compute/math lineages when relevant.
